doc.title: Ralph Sutton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, September 22, 1995

title: Rejoining Teagarden at the Famous Door
summary: He rejoined Teagarden's band at the Famous Door on 52nd Street with Kaminsky, Lesberg, Hucko and Shaughnessy.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: And from then, I did that for about two and a half years and then I re-joined Jack Teagarden, he was going into the Famous Door on 52nd Street. And in the band he had Max Kaminsky, Jack Lesberg, Peanuts Hucko, Eddie Shaughnessy on drums and myself on piano.
You know, Ed Shaughnessy mentioned that engagement to us.
We talked to him in Los Angeles. And that must have been one of his first I think really memorable engagements for him.
Well Eddie is from New York isn’t he?

Yeah. He’s from that area and he told us this story about how he got his first drumset and then he used to go into New York and go into all the clubs. And he mentioned that engagement, that he felt that that was really where he started to feel like yeah, I can do this, this is great. What was 52nd Street and that area of New York like at that time?
